課程綱要.開課單位: 國際經營管理碩士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: Theories and practices are equally emphasized and integrated in this class in order to give an adequate foundation to strategic management. It covers the understanding and analysis of the internal and external business environment and apply the knowledge to strategy formulation and implementation to gain and sustain competitive advantage. Aside from lectures and reports, this course also employs a participative and case teaching method in which learning will be enhanced on class discussions about the key concepts of strategic management and the analysis of cases concerning the topics covered. Presentations, small group discussions, participation, and final exam are required.
課程綱要.授課內容:
1 (2/25) Class Introduction
2 (3/4) Introduction to Strategy and Strategic Processes and Leadership
Suggested Reading: Heavey, C., Simsek, Z., Kyprianou, C., & Risius, M. (2020). How do strategic leaders engage with social media? A theoretical framework for research and practice. Strategic Management Journal, 41(8), 1490-1527.
3 (3/11) External Analysis
Suggested Reading: Aggarwal, V. K., & Reddie, A. W. (2022). New economic statecraft: Industrial policy in an era of strategic competition. In The Strategic Options of Middle Powers in the Asia-Pacific (pp. 105-122). Routledge.
4 (3/18) Case 1: Beyond Meat: Beyond an Uncertain Future
5 (3/25) Internal Analysis
Suggested Reading: Collins, C. J. (2021). Expanding the resource based view model of strategic human resource management. The International Journal of Human Resource Management, 32(2), 331-358.
6 (4/1) Case 2: Iron Corporation: Strategic Reinvention at the Crossroads of Social Media and Cinema
7 (4/8) Competitive Advantage, Firm Performance, and Business Models
Suggested Reading: Geissdoerfer, M., Pieroni, M. P., Pigosso, D. C., & Soufani, K. (2020). Circular business models: A review. Journal of Cleaner Production, 277, 123741.
8 (4/15) Differentiation, Cost Leadership, Blue Oceans
Suggested Reading: Amjad, M. S., Rafique, M. Z., Khan, M. A., Khan, A., & Bokhari, S. F. (2022). Blue Ocean 4.0 for sustainability–harnessing Blue Ocean Strategy through Industry 4.0. Technology Analysis & Strategic Management, 1-16.
9 (4/22) Innovation, Entrepreneurship, and Platforms
Suggested Reading: Fu, X., Li, Y., Li, J., & Chesbrough, H. (2022). When do latecomer firms undertake international open innovation: Evidence from China. Global Strategy Journal, 12(1), 31-56.
10 (4/29) Case 3: DeepSeek: Can It Create and Capture a Blue Ocean in the AI Industry?
11 (5/6) Vertical Integration, and Diversification
Suggested Reading: Sambharya, R. B., & Goll, I. (2021). Do international and product diversification strategies affect human rights and employee orientation disclosures? An across‐country empirical study of large multinational enterprises. Global Strategy Journal, 11(2), 245-268.
12 (5/13) Strategic Alliance, Mergers and Acquisitions
Suggested Reading: Zhu, D. H., & Westphal, J. D. (2021). Structural power, corporate strategy, and performance. Strategic Management Journal, 42(3), 624-651.
13 (5/20) Global Strategy
Suggested Reading: Asmussen, C. G., & Foss, N. J. (2022). Strategizing and economizing in global strategy. Global Strategy Journal, 12(3), 578-591.
14 (5/27) Case 4: Goelia: Going Global
15 (6/3) Reading and Review Week
16 (6/10) Final Exam

課程綱要.開課單位: 國際經營管理碩士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: 相對於地球自然演化的速度，人類正以飛快步伐改變全球樣貌，造成了溫度上升，氣候劇烈變化，以及環境嚴重汙染。某些島嶼型國家因海平面上升，淹沒其國土，必需將部份人民遷往高處，甚至是送往他國（例如斯里蘭卡）。而印尼已決定將其首都遷移至另一都市。在世界某些區域，氣候變遷已明顯對其糧食、飲用水等民生必需品造成影響。而目前全球物種滅絕的速度，更是史無前例。 有鑑於全球環境因人類過去種種不當作為而面臨嚴峻挑戰，世界各國已採取必要措施，針對能源使用、溫室氣體（greenhouse gases）排放、原物料及零組件來源、產品生產及使用過程等，訂定相關策略及法規（例如The Paris Agreement、ErP、RoHS、REACH、WEEE等），以同時兼顧經濟、社會與環境之均衡發展。永續發展（sustainable development)已成為世界各國至關重要之發展方針！ 人類文明仰賴穩定的能源來發展。為有效抑制全球暖化（global warming），使全球平均溫度上升幅度於本世紀末能夠低於2.0°C，甚至是低於1.5°C，各國必需於未來數十年間，廣泛以再生能源（renewable energy）來替換傳統石化能源，以大幅降低溫室氣體（greenhouse gases）排放。但再生能源多半無法持續供電（例如太陽能及風能），生產方式為分散式，所生電力又為直流電，因此如何激勵大眾及私人企業投資，以及如何將再生電力匯聚傳輸以進行有效運用，對各國政府均是重大挑戰。
課程綱要.授課內容:
本課程將聚焦下列議題，以引領修課同學進入再生能源與永續發展領域。
1. 氣候變遷與全球暖化
2. 永續發展與企業社會責任
3. 再生能源與儲能科技
4. 太陽能與風能
5. 再生能源規劃
6. 電動車與運輸電氣化

課程綱要.開課單位: 國際經營管理碩士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程旨在培養學生於不確定環境下進行理性決策的能力，結合理論模型與實務案例，引導學生系統性地分析決策問題，評估替代方案與其後果，並做出具依據的管理決策。透過本課程，學生將能夠：理解決策制定的核心概念與理論基礎。能掌握決策分析的基本架構，包括決策本質、不確定性、風險與資訊價值，建立完整的決策思維基礎。培養結構化與分析性的決策能力,運用決策模型與分析工具，對複雜問題進行結構化分析，包含決策建模、敏感度分析、效用理論與風險評估，以支持理性選擇。強化定量與邏輯推論於決策中的應用能力,能量化判斷、評估資訊價值，並分析不同決策方案的效用與後果，提升決策品質與一致性。理解群體、組織與倫理層面的決策議題,識群體決策（如團體迷思）、組織決策與倫理決策中可能產生的偏誤與挑戰，並提出適當的因應方式。培養實務應用與溝通表達能力透過實務個案研討、小組討論與期末報告，學生能清楚表達決策分析過程與結論，並在團隊合作中有效溝通與整合不同觀點。
課程綱要.授課內容:
本課程以決策制定為核心，探討個人在不確定情境下如何進行判斷與選擇。學生將學習如何系統性地分析策略性決策問題、評估不同方案，並衡量其可能帶來的後果。課程亦將涵蓋群體、組織與倫理層面的決策制定議題。
透過指定閱讀、個案分析與課堂討論，學生將培養分析問題的能力，學習如何量化判斷、評估資訊價值、分析效用，並做出具依據且理性的決策。
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: 參考書 (Reference) Making Hard Decisions with Decision Tools 3rd. Ed. (2013) Robert T. Clemen, Reilly T. Cengage Learning

課程綱要.開課單位: 國際經營管理碩士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: Upon the completion of this course, your will be able to: Challenge your understanding of the concepts and theories in the field of OB.  Appreciate that good managerial skills and decisions are not always intuitive or based on gut-feeling.  Understand and leverage the breadth of theory and concept with respect to individuals, groups, and interpersonal processes within the organizational context.  Think critically about applying the concepts and theories presented in the readings to solve real organizational issues.  Have a sufficient understanding of the OB issues to start thinking about your thesis topic.
課程綱要.授課內容:
A happy environment leads to better and memorable learning outcomes!
This course aims to create a happy environment to provide you with a comprehensive introduction to the wide range of theory, research, and practice in the field organizational behavior (OB). OB is the study of how individuals and groups impact the behavior within an organization. Because organizations are an integral part of many people’s lives and as a member of organizations, you will encounter issues ranging from the individual level to the group level and the organizational level, and you will need to be aware of how these areas fit into your working life. You will learn in great detail, topics regarding individual behavior such as individual differences and motivation. Topics regarding group behavior include team characteristics and leadership, as well as organizational level topics such as organizational culture.
Throughout the course, I strongly encourage you to think of yourself not only as a hardworking student in this course, but also as a “future leader” in an organization (e.g., job, school, cultural, religious or sport) that you are currently associated with or planning to join after graduation or as a “future OB scholar” who likes to apply OB knowledge to help solve actual problems in the organizations. This will allow you to think critically about the information presented in classes. Moreover, by putting yourself in the situation, you can develop one or even more research questions that you are most interested in. These research questions can then be developed into the topic of your thesis!
Course Delivery Format:
This course includes lectures, class discussions, article presentations on peer-reviewed and management magazine articles, and min-case studies. In the second week, you will be asked to form groups of 3-4. Your group will then be responsible to complete article presentations, as well as the final research presentation and written report.
My role as an instructor of the course will be introducing and reviewing the core OB concepts before and after the presentations, as well as, providing additional related materials. More importantly, I wish to stimulate class discussions. You are invited and rewarded to participate in class discussions by raising any related comments or asking questions. Remember that, your participation makes the entire course much more interesting and fun! See you soon!
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Colquitt, LePine, ＆ Wesson (2020). Organizational Behaviour: Improving Performance and Commitment in the Workplace. 7th Edition, McGraw-Hill Ryerson. (Available in the NCU Bookstore). The peer-reviewed journal and management magazine articles are available from the instructor. (Free!)

課程綱要.課程名稱(中文): 人工智慧/機器學習的財務應用
課程綱要.課程目標: Data analytics and adaptive learning are important in modern decision making in almost every fields today. The super computing power and big data open a variety of possibilities to shed new lights in rapid emerging fields like computer science, finance, marketing, social media, politics as well as general social and humanity sciences. This course aims to equip advanced undergraduate and graduate students with the understanding of the state-of-art modelling and algorithm knowledge of artificial intelligence and machine learning in the field of Finance and Economics. Given the structurally designed products, functioning mechanisms and contextual microstructure in Financial markets, we will see how these statistical learning and econometric toolboxes are infused with the financial theory to make the new paradigm shift in modern Finance in field of prediction/forecasting, investment, trading and risk management. Students are expected grasp and apply the discussed concepts and modelling techniques in a team project, turning in 2 exercises, attend the 2 exams, share reflections from the invited talk and field trip, present a team selected paper in the reading list; and present the joint team project with a paper version report in the final. These requirements are designed to help the students reconcile the background knowledge.
課程綱要.授課內容:
The topics and the 3 Main parts reconciling concepts in Statistics/ Econometrics, AIML and Finance/Economics will cover
(A) Essential Econometric/Statistical Concepts:
‧ Trend, Stationarity and Random Walk
‧ ARIMA and GARCH
‧ Structural Breaks, Threshold, and regime Switching
‧ Extreme, Outliers, and Hyperbolic Decay
‧ Principal Component Analysis and Factor Models
‧ Cointegration and Error Correction
‧ Multivariate GARCH ＆ Dynamic Conditional Correlation
‧ General Dependence, Copula, Tail dependence
‧ State Space Models
‧ Simulation and Sampling Recipes
o Monte Carlo simulation
o Random number generation
o Bootstrapping
(B) AIML Toolboxes
‧ Classification Methods: Logit, SVM, Clustering Analysis, KNN
‧ Boosting, Regression Tree, Random Forests
‧ Neural Network, Recurrent NN (RNN), Convolutional ＮN (CNN) , Deep NN (DNN)
‧ Sparse Regression: Shrinkage, LASSO,
‧ Sampling Techniques and (Sequential) Importance Sampling
‧ Kalman Filtering and Updating
‧ Bayesian Approach: MarKov Chain Monte Carlo ＆ Gibbs Sampling
‧ Particle Filtering and Sequential Monte Carlo Methods
‧ Textmining, Sentiment Measurement and Analysis,
‧ Topic modelling, LDA
‧ Robustness to Nonstationarity and Parameter Uncertainty
o Bayesian learning
o Adaptive Learning
(C) Financial Applications
 Predictability

課程綱要.課程目標: Welcome to IM5023, a research-based course focusing on Digital Brand Management with direct relevance to the world of digital marketing (branding). This course is meticulously designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the subject matter through a curated selection of readings encompassing theoretical papers, empirical studies, and reviews. Drawing from an extensive array of journal articles, both classic and contemporary, this course aims to offer a representative sample of the ongoing research within the field. Throughout this course, class sessions will primarily center around in-depth discussions of the assigned readings for each week. It is expected that students come prepared having thoroughly engaged with the materials beforehand. To facilitate meaningful discussions, students are encouraged to not only read the articles but also to make personal notes on points of interest, areas of confusion, and agreements or disagreements with the readings. This practice will serve to enrich our collective understanding of the topic and foster deeper insights into digital brand management strategies. By actively participating in these discussions and engaging critically with the course materials, students will acquire the knowledge and analytical skills necessary to navigate the complex landscape of digital brand management in contemporary business environments.

課程綱要.開課單位: 國際經營管理碩士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程旨在培養學生了解並閱讀公共經濟學的當前學術文獻的能力，並評估這些內容可如何應用於政策分析上。我們將討論公共經濟學的關鍵概念和方法，並介紹與政策相關的研究結果。本課程側重於租稅政策分析，並評估各種租稅工具對個人與企業決策的效果。此外，本課程亦會討論租稅效率成本以及租稅帶來的分配影響。
課程綱要.授課內容:
1. Indirect taxation: Ramsey’s formula
2. Indirect taxation: Productive efficiency
3. Direct taxation: Mirrlees model (the Rawlsian case)
4. Direct taxation: Mirrlees model (the general approach)
5. The taxation of capital: Overlapping generations model
6. The taxation of capital: Chamley–Judd zero capital taxation result
7. Optimal Taxation with Commitment: the primal approach to the Ramsey problem
8. Optimal Taxation with Commitment: labor tax smoothing
9. Optimal Taxation with Commitment: optimal policy in a monetary economy
10. Stiglitz, 1982, Self-selection and efficient taxation, Journal of Public Economics.
11. Saez, 2001, Using elasticities to derive optimal income tax rates, Review of Economic Studies.
12. Heathcote, Storesletten and Violante, 2017, Optimal tax progressivity: an analytical framework, Quarterly Journal of Economics.
13. Chari, Nicolini, and Teles, 2021, Optimal capital taxation revisited, Journal of Monetary Economics.
14. Angelopoulos, Angelopoulos, Lazarakis and Philippopoulos, 2021, The distributional consequences of rent‐seeking, Economic Inquiry.
15. Grubert and Mutti, 1991, Taxes, tariffs and transfer pricing in multinational corporate decision making, Review of Economics and Statistics.

課程綱要.開課單位: 國際經營管理碩士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程旨在幫助學生全面理解領導行為及其對決策過程的影響。透過探索各種領導風格，學生將培養在不同情境下分析領導策略的能力，從而提升批判性思考和實踐應用技能。課程也強調團隊合作和實踐經驗，透過案例討論和團隊活動，增強學生的領導能力、決策判斷力和溝通技巧。
課程綱要.授課內容: 本課程探討領導行為及其對決策過程的影響，涵蓋權變理論和各種領導風格，包括變革型領導、交易型領導、魅力型領導、倫理型領導、服務型領導、願景型領導、共享型領導、跨文化領導、時間型領導和家長式領導。課程將採用講座和課堂討論的形式，並輔以大量的案例研究和團隊活動。學生將以團隊形式合作完成指定的任務和項目，從而培養實務技能和團隊合作能力。
課程綱要.評量配分比重: 1. Participations (25％) 2. Case/Academic Paper Leading (20％) 3. Midterm Reflective Essay (25％) 4. Term Paper (30％)

課程綱要.課程目標: Students are expected to develop a solid foundation in microeconomic analysis, master the basic modelling tools to construct economic models in explaining individual, consumer, and firm’s behavior, derive insights on and evaluate the welfare effects of economic policies.
課程綱要.授課內容: This course introduces students to the fundamentals of microeconomic analysis and enable students’ application of economic tools in understanding and analyzing different economic problems to have a systematic view on the working of economics in the contemporary world.
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Our lectures closely follow Munoz-Garcia, Felix (2017), Advanced Microeconomic Theory: An Intuitive Approach with Examples, 1st Edition, Cambridge, MA: MIT Press (hereinto ““FMG““). Please obtain a copyright version of the textbook to help you better understand the lecture materials and work on the problem sets. I also recommend the accompanying workbook that provides step-to-step workout of odd-number questions, both can be obtained from the campus bookstore or online at www.amazon.com. Supplementary learning materials, such as journal articles and workout examples, will be distributed from time to time. You may also consult the following textbooks for further references. From a more theoretical side, you may read Mas-Colell, Andreu, Whinston, Michael D., and Green, Jerry R. (1995), Microeconomic Theory, 1st Edition, Cambridge, UK: Oxford University Press (hereinto ““MWG““) if you are interested in technical proofs and model-building. A book that focuses on both theory and application which I recommend is Varian Hal R. (1992), Microeconomic Analysis, 3rd Edition, Hoboken, NJ: John Wiley ＆ Sons, Inc. From a more applied side, you may study Jehle, Geoffrey A. and Reny, Philip J. (2011), Advanced Microeconomic Theory, 3rd Edition, Upper Saddle River, NJ: Prentice Hall (hereinto ““JR““) to help you form an intuition on the mechanics of economic models.
課程綱要.評量配分比重: Problem Sets: 8％ x 6, Mid-term Exams: 16％ x 2, Final Exam: 20％
課程綱要.彈性教學說明: The last week is earmarked for final exam review. While there is no formal meeting, students are encouraged to schedule an appointment with the instructor to discuss their overall performance.

課程綱要.授課內容: 本課程將涵蓋法律和經濟學的基礎知識，從科斯定理、物權規則和責任規則，一直到行為法律和經濟學等前沿課題。
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Main References: A. Mitchell Polinsky, An Introduction to Law and Economics (5th ed., 2018). Richard A. Posner, Economic Analysis of Law (9th ed., 2014). Robert D. Cooter ＆ Thomas Ulen, Law and Economics (6th Ed., 2011). Steven Shavell, Foundations of Economic Analysis of Law (2004). Behavioral Law and Economics (Cass R. Sunstein, Ed., 2000). Game Theory and the Law (Douglas Baird, Robert Gertner ＆ Randal Picker eds, 1998). R. H. Coase, The Firm, the Market, and the Law (1990). Ronald H. Coase, The Problem of Social Cost, 3 J. Law ＆ Econ. 1 (1960). Guido Calabresi ＆ A. Douglas Melamed, Property Rules, Liability Rules, and Inalienability: One View of the Cathedral, 85 Harv. L. Rev. 1089 (1972). Margaret Jane Radin, Contested Commodities (2001).
